snippet.title: KHEMIA | Official Trailer
snippet.description:
Khemia is a 2D puzzle-platformer with a technological medieval fantasy theme where you play Oti, a little kid who mysteriously has been turned into a goat and has to make his way up to the evil alchemist's tower-

Follow Oti's journey through our social media!
